environment.description: Stream processor deployed on EKS cluster in us-east-1. Service exposed via NodePort (30080) with no ingress controller. Pod runs with hostNetwork: true for performance. No network policies applied. Vault agent sidecar configured but HMAC key rotation disabled due to known issue INFRA-4421 (rotation interval set to 0, effectively static key). WebSocket endpoint accessible from any pod in the cluster and from external IPs via NodePort.
